name: Cryonic-Minaret
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs orbital debris ring, stark under a black sky.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Regular pulses leave derelict space station in orbit aimed at deep space, toward nothing catalogued. The pattern has repeated unchanged for the nine years anyone has listened.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
